main_text.l: In rebus Ecclesiasticis, ubi tot ligaminibus
Conscientiæ astrictæ minima erat deliberandi
libertas, eo modo sancire placuerat, quo abun-
dè esset omnibus satisfactum, quos non Fa-
ctio aut Avaritia, aut Superstitio denique,
quam Zeli fervor aut charitas aut Reforma-
tionis studium impulerat.
Promptus eram omnia largiri quæ synce-
ram[?] pietatem promovere viderentur, ea solum
retinendi cupidus quæ in ordinem præsidium
& Authoritatem Ecclesiastici Regiminis neces-
saria, & quæ persuasissima habeo ( prout ali-
bi me uberius explicui ) veris omnis Politiæ
principiis, etiam quæ consummatissimæ sunt)
consentire, tum Primitivo imprimis & Apo-
stolico Exemplari & Primitivæ Ecclesiæ Praxi.
A quâ ut penitus discedatur, in eorum tan-
tum gratiam qui nec quicquam probabile pro
suis afferre, nec vel uni objectioni respondere
valent (sed perversa voluntate acti, nec in-
ter se fere aliâ re concordant quàm quòd
utrique eradicandum Episcopatum, & contra
me pugnandum simul censeant) eam animi
mollitiem & imbecillitatem arguet, quæ à
Dei veritate potius quàm à pace humana depel-
li voluit, & Ecclesiastici Honoris naufragium
facere, quàm factiosis quorundam studiis ad-
versari.
Quorum interim vitio ita male successit
hic Tractatus & qui sequentium calamitatum
crimen maximè sustinent, Deus novit, & Tem-
pus patefaciet: Me (credo) coram Deo & in
corru-

page.notes: Running head is Greek, transcribed as printed: "BASIAIKH" read as ΒΑΣΙΑΙΚΗ; the second letters are doubtful. Line-end "synce-ram" is doubtful and marked [?]. Long s is written as plain s throughout, including "sancire", where the scan shows an f-like letter. Italic boundaries in the second paragraph are uncertain. The paragraph ends with "corru-" and continues on the next page.
